decisions.reason: Submarine interior lighting is distant from the core and its value remains uncertain, but defence and maritime procurement cycles are long and keeping the line listed costs little, so the option stays open.
The explosion-proof line serves core industrial customers, rests on sunk certification investments and has proven fit, so continued commitment is justified.
The relaunched designer task light builds on a popular established product and is cheap to keep, although its age raises the chance of eventual replacement by a newer LED version.
The pendant office luminaire is close to the core offer and still young, with no evidence of failure, so keeping this low-cost option open is sensible while office demand recovers after the pandemic.
The premium pendant line with several models fits the established office lighting business and has had too little time to reveal its value, so the firm keeps it.
